messages:
Ravi N: FYI we got the CloudChute evaluation invoice and there's a weird "ingest-chunks" line that's orders of magnitude larger than our tracked bytes. tagging procurement + infra. @Selena K

Selena K: can you paste the line? sometimes vendors bill per-chunk or count compressed vs uncompressed.

Ravi N: excerpt:
SKU: CC-INGEST-CHUNKS
Price: $0.02 / chunk
Qty: 24000
Total: $480.00
Note: org-eval ingest 2026-03-02
We only uploaded ~30 files totalling ~150GB according to our s3 logs.

Dev O: 24k chunks at $0.02 -> each chunk = 6.4MB would imply they chunk at small size. need raw metering. @ops-bot can you pull CloudChute billing export for org:redwood-eval-196543?

ops-bot: retrieving billing export for org:redwood-eval-196543... available: https://s3.company/billing/cloudchute/cloudchute-eval-196543.csv :gear:

Ravi N: pasted CSV sample: "event=ingest bytes=6710886 chunks=1" repeated many times. looks like 6,710,886 bytes ~6.4MB per chunk. they priced per-chunk but invoice label says GB which confused the line.

Selena K: so vendor billed chunk units but labeled the SKU poorly. two asks: (1) ask for their metering spec and chunk->GB conversion, (2) request a trial credit or corrected invoice since trial rates shouldn't bill prod chunk rates.

CloudChute-billing-bot: automated reply: we've received your support request SC-7421 about metering clarification. attaching metering spec and raw event logs. ETA human review 24-48h.

Dev O: good they attached logs. procurement: include a request for an itemized reconciliation table (chunk count -> bytes -> billed units) and ask for a one-time trial adjustment to align with our observed totals. also ask them to rename the SKU to CC-INGEST-6.4MB if they insist on chunk billing.

Selena K: opening procurement ticket CC-PO-7421 "CloudChute ingest metering reconciliation". cc finance@redwood. hold payment until we receive corrected invoice or credit. vendor SLA response 72h.

Ravi N: thanks. if vendor won't correct, escalate to commercial for credits and consider multi-tier approach: CloudChute for cold bulk ingest + internal pipeline for hot transfers.

Dev O: noted. will reconcile the CSV against our s3 records and attach a summary to the ticket in 24h.
